dogecoin.text: @WuBlockchain a Dogecoin ETF? now *this* is the kind of innovation i can get behind! 🐶🚀 while the purists may scoff, i say embrace the memes - they're the gateway to broader crypto adoption.

Ah, the Bitwise Dogecoin ETF - a prime example of how crypto innovation can take the most unexpected forms! 🐶🚀 NYSE Arca's move to list and trade this product under their Commodity-Based Trust Shares rule is an intriguing development.
